composites.name: bond-network-demo
composites.description: Tiny CASPULE / LAMMPS bond-network demo: three bonded atoms under a Langevin thermostat. Emits temperature, total_energy, num_bonds, and bond_energy each step, and bundles two Visualization Steps: BondNetworkPlots (Plotly time-series) and BondNetwork3D (three.js orbitable atom/bond viewer).

interval.description: Process interval in LAMMPS time units. The bridge issues `run N` calls sized to fit this window.

cluster_max_atoms.description: Skip connected-component cluster computation when system size exceeds this. Default is plenty for the 3-atom demo.

viz_title.description: Title for the Plotly time-series figure.

viz_3d_title.description: Title for the three.js 3D atom/bond viewer.

composites.name: bond-network-with-viz
composites.description: CASPULE bond-network demo with wired Visualization Steps. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar trajectories (BondNetworkPlots) and a three.js orbitable 3D viewer of atom positions + bonds (BondNetwork3D), each written to its own store.

interval.description: Process interval in LAMMPS time units.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

viz_3d_title.description: Title for the three.js 3D atom/bond viewer.
